# VOUT Inbox · Multi-Tenant Customer Feedback Platform
> Multi-tenant customer feedback platform with embeddable web forms and signed HMAC-SHA256 webhooks.

## Overview
VOUT Inbox centralizes inbound communication from websites, web applications, and customer touchpoints into a unified, isolated multi-tenant triage console.

## Core Capabilities
- Strict tenant data isolation via organization-scoped PostgreSQL queries
- Embeddable widget forms via `<iframe>` and REST API v1
- Cryptographically signed HMAC-SHA256 outbound webhooks with retry policy
- Instant triage status workflow (New, In Progress, Resolved, Archived)
- Internal notes and team collaboration audit trail

## Live Demo & Endpoints
- Production Live URL: https://saas-am.vercel.app
- Live Demo Access: https://saas-am.vercel.app/demo
- Live Inbox: https://saas-am.vercel.app/inbox
- Source Code: https://github.com/AgustinMilesi/inbox

## Technical Stack
- Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4
- Prisma ORM 6 on Neon Serverless PostgreSQL
- Resend API for transactional alerts
- Creator: Agustín Milesi (https://github.com/AgustinMilesi)
